required_checks.name: design_topic_coverage
required_checks.method: Same-agent original-source semantic review plus mapping checks
required_checks.evidence: 11 recognized topics have substantive overall sections and independent details; 10 business modules reconciled; no unresolved boundary. document-plan.json retains the map.

required_checks.name: document_naming
required_checks.method: Host path/H1 checks and semantic presentation review
required_checks.evidence: 16 flat Chinese semantic Markdown paths; README exception; H1 topics match filenames.

required_checks.name: document_associations
required_checks.method: Host parsing of actual candidates, card bindings, figure uses and explicit anchors
required_checks.evidence: structure-check.json: Exit 0, 840 relative references; 16 articles, 11 cards and 25 figure pairs; current reverse bindings derived from actual references.

required_checks.name: document_outline
required_checks.method: Host chapter checks plus same-agent substantive outline review and actual Markdown preview
required_checks.evidence: 14 design articles use the chosen seven-chapter category outlines; overall separates requirements, goals, capabilities, architecture and 11 topic details; tables and headings visually inspected.

required_checks.name: functional_point_coverage
required_checks.method: Original entrypoint/contract review and per-point prose/figure assessment
required_checks.evidence: document-plan.json retains source paths, overall/detail/answer sections, scenario sections and figure applicability; data/deployment concerns have reader questions without invented user features.

required_checks.name: detailed_design_depth
required_checks.method: Same-agent content check, separate expression pass, fact recheck and static normal/alternative walkthrough review
required_checks.evidence: Content review and C065 impact review cover contracts, precedence, cache append/rebuild, OAuth renewal/failure, lock/manual/unlock, ratio analytics and publishing; no runtime or independent-review claim.

required_checks.name: article_figure_coverage
required_checks.method: Semantic applicability review and actual Markdown image references
required_checks.evidence: 25 figures across 26 embeddings cover relationships, internal flows, states, transformations and error retention. Per-point no-figure reasons describe actual field-only or bounded local rules; no deferred required views.

required_checks.name: figure_structure_and_meaning
required_checks.method: JSON/XML parsing and source-to-node/relation manual semantic review
required_checks.evidence: All SVG/list IDs and endpoints map one-to-one; source refs are original files; conditions, direction, payload and ownership reviewed. Source-kind declarations retained for CI.

required_checks.name: standalone_svg_visual
required_checks.method: rsvg-convert 2.62.3 and actual image inspection; unchanged prior view evidence reused by exact hash
required_checks.evidence: 18 new SVGs inspected at width 1000. Seven unchanged SVG/list pairs match prior manifest hashes and retain prior standalone evidence; all also inspected in current Chrome embedding.

required_checks.name: markdown_embedding_visual
required_checks.method: Bundled marked + isolated offline Chrome 155.0.8059.85; actual page/figure screenshots
required_checks.evidence: 16 pages rendered at content width 920, final viewport 1120x1600; 26 loaded images, no horizontal overflow or wide tables. Earlier overflow and screenshot crop were repaired; C065 changed three pages were rendered again.

required_checks.name: source_and_owned_output_guard
required_checks.method: Immediate SHA-256 comparison and confirmed-manifest equality
required_checks.evidence: 442 inventory files unchanged from recovered current C065 baseline; all 39 prior owned content files match confirmed hashes; new targets must be unoccupied before delivery.

candidate_and_optional_checks.evidence: Exit 1 for missing exact literal; content edits retained; corrected exact literal and next command Exit 0

candidate_and_optional_checks.name: first_svg_visual
candidate_and_optional_checks.evidence: Five label/clearance defects repaired locally, then inspected again; visual-repair.json

candidate_and_optional_checks.name: unicode_host_edit

candidate_and_optional_checks.name: first_markdown_launch

candidate_and_optional_checks.name: first_markdown_overflow
candidate_and_optional_checks.evidence: One long signature overflowed; symbol and individual argument names retain the contract and remove overflow. Final report has zero overflow.

candidate_and_optional_checks.name: external_workspace_interruption
candidate_and_optional_checks.method: Current paths, git branch/HEAD and original collection hashes
candidate_and_optional_checks.evidence: External branch switch removed untracked candidates. Exact own tool inputs recovered the drafts; confirmed outputs remained intact. recovery-receipt.json and c065-impact-review.json record bounded recovery.

candidate_and_optional_checks.name: application_tests
candidate_and_optional_checks.method: Documentation-only work; no application build, Harness execution, credentials or external requests
candidate_and_optional_checks.evidence: Source test definitions are evidence of expected cases only. No runtime/device/human acceptance was performed.

verification.tool_checks: JSON/XML 解析、路径与锚点、840 处相对引用、SHA-256、关联绑定、离线渲染与布局测量、git diff。
verification.semantic_review: 同一会话内进行了原始来源核对、内容审查、单独表达编辑、事实复查和实际图片检查；没有独立审查声明。
not_run: Rust 或 Swift 自动化用例执行
真实 Keychain ACL 交互验收
verification.evidence_boundary: 源码测试定义只说明预期场景，文档校验不构成软件运行或生产验收。

markdown.mode: 隔离、离线、本地候选内容

preview.limits: 使用本机可用 Markdown 解析器与 Chrome；项目未声明生产 Markdown 阅读器。不推及其他客户端、PDF 或 Word 的布局表现。

interruption_and_conflicts.description: 外部切换分支曾移除未跟踪候选；确认旧正式产物完整后，从本会话自己的精确工具输入恢复草稿，保留 local 数据并核对当前 C065 源码。13 篇未受 C065 影响的恢复页面与原已查预览正文完全相同；3 篇受影响文章重新渲染。
interruption_and_conflicts.ownership: 只替换已确认所有权的知识库产物；没有回滚源码、切换分支、提交或推送。

retained_candidates.purpose: 已通过检查的候选副本与恢复材料，不表示未完成工作。

next_invocation: 基于下次运行时的原始来源与已确认 manifest 做增量检查；复用未变内容，仅更新受影响章节和图示。
